product.note: Parts only: screws and fittings aren’t shown, and sizes are approximate. Each step names the page of your paper manual to follow.

steps.title: Start with 4 legs and a board
steps.instruction: Join 4 legs and a board (A, B, C, D, E), as the animation shows. Page 4 of the IKEA manual shows this step.
checklist: 4 legs and a board are joined

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the ÄPPLARÖ table. Page 4 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
The blue parts: A (leg, about 64 cm), B (board, about 163 cm), C (leg, about 63 cm), D (leg, about 63 cm), E (leg, about 63 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 72 cm tall.
